//buildCommand: Runs the monorepo build script to compile all packages and the Next.js app
//outputDirectory: Points to the Next.js build output from the web app workspace
//installCommand: Installs all workspace dependencies from the monorepo root
//framework: Tells Vercel to use Next.js optimizations (ISR, edge functions, image optimization)
//rewrites: Ensures /api/* paths are passed through as-is to Next.js API routes rather than being treated as static assets
